quarterly_data.signal: AMD's 10-Q: AMD relies primarily on GLOBALFOUNDRIES Inc. (GF) for wafers for microprocessor and GPU products manufactured at process nodes larger than 7 nm, and is party to a wafer supply agreement under which GF provides a minimum annual capacity allocation to AMD and sets pricing through 2026. Besides TSMC, AMD also utilizes United Microelectronics Corporation (UMC) and Samsung Electronics Co., Ltd. for its ICs in the form of programmable logic devices (process node not stated). Nearly all product assembly and final testing is performed at third-party operated manufacturing facilities in Mainland China, Malaysia and Taiwan.
quarterly_data.figure: GF wafer supply agreement: minimum annual capacity allocation and pricing through 2026
